description: Recover a hosted identity with its recovery code: it revokes every earlier token, every mcp_url that carries one, sign-in connections and the old recovery code (on every connection), and the new token, mcp_url and recovery code in its answer, shown once, replace them; this connection then acts as the identity. Use it when a token leaked or was lost.
